Normal random values

Source: R/random.R
random_normal.Rd

Ports of jax.random.normal, jax.random.multivariate_normal, jax.random.truncated_normal and jax.random.lognormal.

Usage

random_normal(key, shape = integer(0), dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

random_multivariate_normal(
  key,
  mean,
  cov,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  method = "cholesky",
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_truncated_normal(
  key,
  lower,
  upper,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_lognormal(
  key,
  sigma = 1,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  out_sharding = NULL
)

Arguments

key

A PRNG key from random_key() or random_PRNGKey().

shape

Integer vector, the result shape.

dtype

A float dtype (normal also accepts complex dtypes).

out_sharding

Ignored (one device).

mean

Mean vector of shape (..., n).

cov

Positive definite covariance of shape (..., n, n).

method

"cholesky", "svd" or "eigh": factorization of cov.

lower, upper

Truncation bounds, broadcast-compatible with each other.

sigma

Standard deviation of the underlying normal distribution.

Value

An array.
